rule: Every figure re-derived from source at run time. Nothing quoted from an earlier artefact of this project. UNCONFIRMED and LOWER BOUND are labelled as such.

1_pericarditis_reading_in_full.the_demonstration: 0 of 5 trials show posted results in the registry; 4 of 5 have a resolved publication. The registry-derived view of this reading reported that NOTHING had reported.

publication.numbers_found_in: abstract (percentages only; arm counts NOT stated)

publication.why: The registration carries no reference and none was resolved. Reported unresolvable, never approximated. This is NOT evidence that no publication exists.

trials.registered_primary_title_VERBATIM: Number of participants with complete response to treatment

and_they_are_not_one_estimand.NCT00128453: ICAP -- a FIRST ATTACK of acute pericarditis. Its PUBLISHED primary is 'incessant or recurrent pericarditis', counting INCESSANT disease.
and_they_are_not_one_estimand.so: Three disease stages under one registered title. The population is part of the estimand and the registry's outcome-title field carries none of it.

3_the_headline_fraction.THE_DENOMINATOR_THAT_MATTERS: 53 completed-and-unposted registrations exist in this set. ONLY 5 HAVE BEEN CHECKED against the literature -- the pericarditis reading. The fraction 4/5 is therefore a fraction OF THE CHECKED, not of the 53, and the paper must say so. Generalising it to the 53 would be exactly the inference this paper argues against.
3_the_headline_fraction.status: LOWER BOUND on the unchecked remainder; EXACT on the checked.

SUPERSEDED_BY_THE_FULL_CHECK.three_states_kept_separate: The 22 are NO_PUBLICATION_RESOLVED, NOT unpublished. Two routes were run against them -- the registration reference list and PubMed by registration identifier -- and both returned nothing. Publisher search, grey literature and non-CTgov registry cross-links were NOT run. Counting the 22 as unpublished would be the exact inference this paper argues against.
SUPERSEDED_BY_THE_FULL_CHECK.status: EXACT on the two routes run. The PUBLISHED count is a LOWER BOUND: further routes could only move trials from NO_PUBLICATION_RESOLVED into PUBLISHED, never the reverse.

A_phase_NA.CORRECTION: An earlier artefact of this project (evidence/2026-08-19-batch1/SUBMISSION-REFERENCES.md) states this as 'recall on ablation-af-review from 4/4 to 2/4'. BOTH the fraction and the topic name are WRONG. Measured: topic `ablation-af-medical-therapy`, recall 3/3 WITHOUT the filter and 1/3 WITH it, over a 3-trial recall target. The surfaced counts 931 and 143 ARE correct. That reference list was delivered for a submission and must be corrected before use.

B_condition_term_one_word_narrower.why_it_was_missed: The query asked for VENOUS thromboembolism; the registration is coded with the broader term. Confirm against the `conditions_as_registered` list above.
B_condition_term_one_word_narrower.recall_effect: On `dabigatran-vte-review` the object held 4 trials and the executed search surfaced 2 of them: recall 2/4, RECORDED and not repaired.
B_condition_term_one_word_narrower.status: CONFIRMED for the coding; recall figure is from the topic's own record.

C_concealed_by_an_unexhausted_cursor.why: Surfaced on PAGE 2 ONLY of a 137-record search. A screen stopping at page 1 would have reported a complete-looking cascade missing the largest trial in its own included set.

5_surfaced_only_after_a_restriction_was_.CORRECTION: The brief asks for 'the three you found in the phase sweep'. THE MEASURED NUMBER IS 2, not three, and they come from ONE topic of 2 measurable. The third topic in the file, `early-rhythm-control-af`, has a SINGLE query and is therefore not measurable for this purpose at all. Reported as measured.
5_surfaced_only_after_a_restriction_was_.status: LOWER BOUND, and heavily so. Only 2 topics in this corpus have more than one recorded query, so restriction-removal was measurable on 2 topics out of roughly 135 live. The corpus-wide figure is UNKNOWN, not small.
